array.string: cd ~/Documents/codeRepo/AIForgeCrew/scripts/graph_rag && \ mkdir -p /tmp/graph_rag && \ for env in qa prod; do \ ~/aiforge-venv/bin/python k8s_sync.py --env $env --kubeconfig /tmp/kube-$env.yaml --context $env --namespaces default pos mongodb 2>/dev/null > /tmp/graph_rag/k8s-$env.jsonl && \ rsync -az /tmp/graph_rag/k8s-$env.jsonl mani@192.168.70.191:/tmp/graph_rag/k8s-$env.jsonl && \ ssh mani@192.168.70.191 "cd ~/AIForgeCrew/scripts/graph_rag && ~/aiforge-venv/bin/python ingest_k8s.py /tmp/graph_rag/k8s-$env.jsonl --neo4j bolt://127.0.0.1:7687" ; \ done
